hero.label: Made for Novig
hero.headline: Driven by a passion for startups, I choose Novig.
hero.subheadline: Joining Novig as a Market Operations Specialist excites me because of the direct impact on growth and the dynamic startup environment. I'm eager to apply my skills in operations to help propel Novig forward.

whyCompany.title: Innovative market solutions
whyCompany.body: Novig stands out for its unique approach to market operations, which aligns with my interest in transformative strategies. I'm excited about contributing to and learning from their market innovations.

whyCompany.title: Early-stage dynamism
whyCompany.body: Being part of an early-stage startup like Novig offers the thrill of growth and new challenges. This is an opportunity to directly influence the company's trajectory and witness its evolution firsthand.

whyCompany.title: Combining sales and marketing savvy
whyCompany.body: My BDR role at Copygen.ai honed my skills in crafting compelling outreach strategies. At NextAfter, I gained insights into digital marketing. Together, these experiences uniquely position me to excel in Novig's operations.

quote: I want to join Novig to directly impact market operations, driving growth and learning within an innovative startup landscape.
